theorem: The Schur (24_4,32_3) root configuration is exactly the rank-three coset geometry of the W33 extraspecial-plus phase kernel E: its points are the E-torsor and its lines are the 24 left cosets of three V4 subgroups whose images form one ruling of Q^+(3,2).
